svg.title: R-provisions-P - Provisions Hold & Cold Store - plan
svg.text: CLEAR: 2.8 m forklift lane from the corridor door into the hold
The Provisions Hold is the ship's larder: frozen and chilled food in a cold store on the hull side, dry goods,
oils and staples on pallets and shelving, and an inventory desk that tells the galley what is left.
Cold store: cryo storage tanks (west hull wall)
Cold store: freezers and refrigerators (inner row)
Nitrogen supply and liquid-nitrogen dewars (north-west corner)
Dry goods shelving and water buffer (north wall)
Oils, drinks and tinned stock (south pallet row)
South wall: small stores and ration lockers
Forklift and pallet jack (east wall, south of the door)
Inventory desk and terminal (east wall, north of the door)
Rations and dry goods on the shelving
Floor props as oriented footprints (front edge heavy); wall items = bars on wall; ceiling items dotted
DECK 4 - HOLD DECK - FLOOR PLAN AT FFL -4.000
